subject: pri-info
title: PRI.INFO.------AF.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 241 (T(IMP)M-39). PRI-INFO (principle information) is the subject. The title names AF-DY (affinity dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics), RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits), ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From RT-INT-TR: SOC-RT-P (social reality particular). From ALT-F: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) and LG-DY (logical dynamics). From INFO-DE-B: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From EXP-DYM: POST (postulation). From LG-DY: APL-DY. From INFO-AF-B: PER-DY (perception dynamics).
